gable.mode: built-in image generation, followed by two edits
inputs: Four-view map capture with character scale reference
prompts:
Create a new game-ready PNG sprite atlas, exactly four views of the SAME humble gable-roof cottage. Image 1 is the authoritative FOUR-VIEW geometry and scale guide. Image 2 is ONLY an ink/watercolour MATERIAL reference; its architecture was oversized, so do NOT copy its proportions.
Output one square 2x2 atlas: TOP LEFT southeast = entrance left/window right; TOP RIGHT northeast = window left/plain rear right; BOTTOM LEFT northwest = plain rear left/window right; BOTTOM RIGHT southwest = window left/entrance right. Preserve the same walls, window and tiny cross location across rotations. North rear wall is plain with no doorway or cross.
CRITICAL HUMAN SCALE: In image 1, the purple block is an adult of height 0.55 units. The entrance opening is ONLY 0.7 high and 0.4 wide. Walls are 0.9 high; roof rises 0.825. The cottage footprint INCLUDING eaves is 2.5x2.5, NOT the 5x5 outline around it. Closely trace the cottage silhouette, door opening, eave and ridge from image 1. Do not enlarge, recenter, or vertically stretch the cottage to fill the empty cell. Each cottage occupies only roughly a third of cell width, with ground-centre anchor at normalized (0.5,0.72). Match the door size, roof pitch and roof/wall ratio to image 1.
Camera exactly orthographic true isometric 35.264° elevation, ground edges 30° to horizontal. Verticals vertical. Four 90° rotations, not mirrored copies.
Art: warm cream daub, simple oak framing, a low stone footing, thick but modest straw eaves, a tiny wooden cross above the entrance. Quiet golden straw, sparse clusters of brown pen strokes following the slope, broad flat watercolour washes. More restrained than image 2; no dense engraving. Readable at small game size. Do not draw the roof as planks or tiles.
TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. Remove the terrain, road, plot outline, purple person, cast shadows and all guide context. Output just the FOUR separate complete building cutouts in their exact guide locations. No people, labels, text, borders, scenic base, painted checkerboard, white or ivory background. Preserve real alpha around the buildings. Keep identical camera scale and anchor in every cell.

Edit this four-view building atlas with ONE change: replace ALL checkerboard outside the buildings with a completely UNIFORM SOLID warm ivory #f3eddf background. Do not draw any checker pattern. This is an OPAQUE concept illustration, not a transparent sprite. Preserve all four buildings, their geometry, identical size, positions, architecture, openings, materials, ink lines, colours and four camera angles exactly. No shadows, labels, terrain or additional objects.

Edit this FOUR VIEW cottage concept atlas with a single architectural change: make each of the TWO doorway openings 25% shorter, keeping their thresholds fixed and keeping the same width. Lower the lintel and cross by the same amount, filling the space above with the existing pale plaster. The current doorways are too tall relative to the game characters. Keep the overall wall heights, foundation positions, roof sizes, roof directions, window locations, materials and all FOUR viewing angles unchanged. Two front views have one door each; two rear views have NO doors. Preserve each building's size and placement within its quadrant. Keep the solid warm ivory backdrop and ink/watercolour style. No people, labels or checkerboard.
